name: L Shitai ne!
source:
"Houshou High School".... famous for beautiful male students. The biggest event is a school festival, held in autumn. Every student looks forward to this event and works hard for it. "Love Season, Autumn", this is a love story among students and teachers.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090402065410/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/cPath/146_52/products_id/1005595]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
“丰寿高中”……以美丽的男学生而闻名。最大的活动是秋季举行的学园祭。每个同学都对这次活动充满期待，并为之努力。《爱情季节·秋天》，这是一个学生和老师之间的爱情故事。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090402065410/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/cPath/146_52/products_id/1005595]ErogeShop[/url]]
